from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCitationInfo(BaseModel):
    """One document from the collection, recording its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as written")
    cites_other_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (from the known collection) that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentCitationInfo]
